시편 41:1.content: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.

시편 41:2.content: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

시편 41:3.content: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

시편 41:4.content: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

시편 41:5.content: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

시편 41:6.content: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

시편 41:7.content: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

시편 41:8.content: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

시편 41:9.content: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

시편 41:10.content: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

시편 41:11.content: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

시편 41:12.content: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

시편 41:13.content: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
